reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

I took this from the incident channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka Sundaram said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give a street address or other site details. I also couldn't find any shared Tansley account files to check, so I told Tobias the only detail available is the name "Southgate".
